notes.title: The Language of Love Release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

I thought I'd let you know I've released my newest VN, The Language of Love! It's a kinetic BxG romance story, and it's quite different from The Way We All Go...
But you might spot a familiar face from TWWAG in LoL, if you check it out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1027620/The_Language_of_Love/

- ebi x
